About this app

Marketing OS

Marketing OS is a personal marketing-automation and API-integration toolkit that I, Tolga Polat, build and operate for my own use — it is not a public product, and it is not offered as a service to third parties.

What it does

Marketing OS connects to advertising and analytics platform APIs (for example Google Ads, Google Analytics, and Google Search Console) using credentials I control, to manage accounts that I own or am directly authorized to administer. It is used to:

  • read performance and configuration data from those accounts
  • generate reports and recommendations
  • make changes to campaigns or content when I direct it to

Who operates it

Marketing OS is operated by a single person — me. There is no public signup, no multi-tenant hosting, and no third-party access. Data retrieved through it stays within my own infrastructure and is never sold or shared outside the account it came from.

Data & contact

Full details are in the privacy policy and terms of service. Questions: tlqplt@gmail.com.
